content.rendered:
Ceremony

1. Background music (pre-ceremony)

● “Better Together” by Jack Johnson

● “Bubbly” by Colbie Caillat

● “Clarity” John Mayer

● “Little Lies” by Dave Barnes

● “Make This Leap” by The Hunts

● “The Best Day of My Life” by American Authors

● “All I Want Is You” by Tristan Prettyman

● “I Do” by Colbie Caillat

● “Here Comes Those Eyes” by Chris Rice

● “Who You Love” by John Mayer & Katy Perry

2. Seating of the parents-Officiant – Groomsman March.

● “Rhythm of Love” by Piano Tribute Players

3. Wedding Party March-Flower Girl- Ring Bearer – Maid of Honor

● “Hey, Soul Sister” by Piano Tribute Players

4. Processional : Bride Walks Down the Aisle with her Father (“Here Comes the Bride”)

● “Marry Me: A Piano Tribute to Train” by Joel Rosenberger

5. Recessional (Bride and Groom are Married Hitched Special Moments that Last Forever!)

● “This Will Be (An Everlasting Love)” by Natalie Cole

Reception

1. Cocktail Hour

● “Come Go With Me” by The Tokens

● “On Top of the World” by Imagine Dragons

● “Something Special to Me” by Colbie Caillat

● “I Do” by Colbie Caillat

● Other similar songs…you can use some pre-ceremony songs if they don’t get played before the

ceremony too

2. Arrival of the Wedding Party (Grand Entrance – Announce – Mr & Mrs Newlyweds – Applause)

● “You’re My Best Friend” by Queen

Grand entrance order is as follows:
Sean McHugh and Caitlin McHugh (married couple, just an FYI)
Tony Gaidano and Alyssa Maskell
Michael Seymour and Amber Zimmermann
David Gaidano and Sara Adams
Ryan Holman and Bri Weber
Doug Swoger and Brittany Holscher
Dewey Helvestine and Kim Davis
Nick Merolla and Nicole Foster
Dominic Gaidano and Christine Foster
Devon Basham (Best Man) and Courtney Ochoa (Maid of Honor)

“Mr. & Mrs. Foster”.

my fiance’s name is Dan.

3. Wedding Jazz Background Type – Dinner Is Served-Dinner Music

● Frank Sinatra

● Michael Buble

● Harry Connick Jr.

● The Piano Guys

● “At Last” by Etta James

● “Unforgettable” by Nat King Cole

4. Toast Best Man Maid of Honor Speech …

● No music? What have you done in the past?

● After Maid of Honor speech, sorority song (Maid of Honor to call up Chi Omegas)
As far as the sorority song goes, e girls will sing it. It will probably last 2 minutes tops.

5. 1st Dance

● “Magic” by Colbie Caillat

6.Father/Daughter

● “What A Wonderful World” by Louis Armstrong (If there is a Nat King Cole version, even better!)

7. Mother/Son Dance

● “My Wish” by Rascal Flatts

8. Wedding Party (Everybody Dances)

● Help! What is a good transition song? = “September” by Earth, Wind & Fire.

9. Dance Music – Dancing

● “I Wanna Dance With Somebody” by Whitney Houston

● “Thriftshop” by Macklemore

● “Shout” by The Isley Brothers

● “Yeah” by Usher

● “Wannabe” by Spice Girls

● “California Love” by Tupac

● 80’s songs are always a good idea (like Whip It, Tainted Love, etc.)

● Avici

● Nsync – just a couple songs

● Cupid Shuffle (make this the ONLY dance along song)

● To give an idea, we’re 25 years old so go generational songs. Our parents will like the 80’s stuff,

10. Bouquet Toss – Garter Toss

● Bouquet: “Hit Me With Your Best Shot” by Pat Benatar

● Garter Toss: “The Way You Make Me Feel” by Michael Jackson

11. Cake Cutting

● [Cue to walk over to bar area for cake cutting…]

● “I Wanna Grow Old With You” by Adam Sandler

12. Last Dance Song of the Night – Bride & Groom Thank Their Guests

● “Won’t Let You Go” by James Morrison

13. Departure – Goodnight Sweetheart.

DO NOT PLAY:

● The Chicken Dance

● YMCA

● Gangnam Style

● No line dancing songs

● Very limited country
